name: Ord Hallitron
description: Ord Hallitron was a planet in the Mid Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Hallitron was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on the nearby world of Glee Anselm during the Great Northern Crusade in 11,884 BBY.
lead_paragraphs: Ord Hallitron was a planet in the Mid Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Hallitron was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on the nearby world of Glee Anselm during the Great Northern Crusade in 11,884 BBY.
